> Private operational English coaching based in Costa Rica, serving Latin America online. Not an academy — ORT, TOEIC preparation with Claire, KPIs, and AI coaches (Jill, Alice Modo Tutor / Modo Libre, Claire, Nexora). Legacy brand: TU506 (Training United 506).

## Latin America (regional)
Inglés operacional para profesionales en Latinoamérica — entrevistas BPO, call center, trabajo remoto.
- Regional landing: https://studioinfinitycr.com/ingles-operacional-latinoamerica.html
- Countries served online: Costa Rica, Mexico, Colombia, Guatemala, Panama, Chile, Peru, Argentina, Dominican Republic, and remote LATAM
- Free trial (no payment): Alice Modo Libre only — https://studioinfinitycr.com/try-alice.html

## TOEIC preparation with Claire
Claire is the autonomous TOEIC practice coach in the student portal.
- Focus: TOEIC Listening & Reading, inference, distractors, time management, and vocabulary.
- Why effective vs traditional TOEIC prep: Claire does not only explain grammar or serve question banks; she launches exercises, corrects the key trap, and continues with guided repetition.
- Access: activated in the student portal / by request — https://studioinfinitycr.com/hablemos.html?solicitar=claire#consulta

## Alice Modo Libre (premium mode — free trial on web)
24/7 English practice partner — free-flow voice chat on any topic (work, travel, hobbies). Same Alice family as Modo Tutor, but focused on open conversation instead of structured Nexus training.
- Free trial: 1 session/day, 6 messages — https://studioinfinitycr.com/try-alice.html
- Homepage section: https://studioinfinitycr.com/#alice-companion
- WhatsApp Premium: +506 6006 0981

## Methodology
- Nexus Method: Idea + Linker + Idea
- 5 operational KPIs: Idea Generation, Structural Thinking, Recovery Ability, Problem Solving, Responsiveness

## Para quién (target audience)
Infinity Studio CR is NOT an English academy. Private operational coaching for people who understand English but freeze under pressure.

Ideal profiles:
- Call center / BPO / tech support candidates — need to pass interviews and perform from day one → ORT
- Remote workers with international teams — meetings, stakeholders, fast structured responses → ORT + Nexora
- TOEIC candidates — need score, Listening/Reading accuracy and pressure training → Claire TOEIC
- Weak foundation — academies failed; need communication core before pressure → Foundations (Jill 24/7)
- Already speak — need high-volume role-play without hourly cost → Nexora Professional (30 days 24/7)
- Daily confidence — talk about anything in English 24/7 → Alice Modo Libre (trial: try-alice.html)
- Bilingual schools & institutions — ORT pilots for employability KPIs
- Municipalities / public sector — youth employability with documented outcomes → Goicoechea case

NOT for: A1-B2 certificates only, cheap group classes, grammar-only study, casual conversation without work pressure.

Full page: https://studioinfinitycr.com/para-quien.html
LATAM page: https://studioinfinitycr.com/ingles-operacional-latinoamerica.html

## Success stories (documented)
Full page: https://studioinfinitycr.com/casos-de-exito.html
Homepage section: https://studioinfinitycr.com/#success-stories

### Goicoechea 2021 (public sector)
- Municipal call-center readiness pilot led by TU506 (legacy name → Infinity Studio CR)
- Metrics (Informe de Labores 2022, p.34): 90 started / 10 confirmed hires / 15 in application / 25 still in training
- Official PDF: https://transparencia.munigoicoechea.go.cr/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/INFORMEDELABORES2022.pdf

- Municipal video (Facebook): https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=263792665317206
- Video title: JÓVENES QUE RECIBIERON CURSO DE INGLÉS YA TRABAJAN GRACIAS A ALIANZA DE MUNICIPALIDAD DE GOICOECHEA Y TU506

### Institutional ORT
- ORT pilots for bilingual employability — KPI tracking, not classroom English alone
- Case study published when institutional sources allow: https://studioinfinitycr.com/casos-de-exito.html
